title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

texts.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

texts.zh: 尽管生物学领域的积累并未救伊拉斯人于水火，但是他们，毫无疑问，是这一方面的专家。我们的科学家已从他们的发现中吸取了富有价值的经验。
texts.en: Though it clearly did not save them, the Irassians were admittedly experts in the field of biology. Our scientists have adapted what was worthwhile from their findings.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将伊拉斯人的文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对生命科学的见解将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Irassian artifacts into our research process. Their insights into biological research will greatly aid our own.
